name: Frontend
description: A complete frontend roadmap with all the technologies required

children.name: HTML
children.description: Complete HTML roadmap from fundamentals through advanced HTML, accessibility, browser concepts, security, and practical projects.

children.name: CSS
children.description: Complete CSS roadmap from fundamentals through modern layout, responsive design, animations, architecture, accessibility, and practical projects.

children.name: CSS Fundamentals
children.description: Understand what CSS is, how it works, and how CSS rules are applied to HTML.

children.name: Selectors
children.description: Master CSS selectors and how the browser determines which elements a rule applies to.

children.name: Cascade, Specificity & Inheritance
children.description: Understand how conflicting CSS rules are resolved and inherited.

children.name: Values, Units & Functions
children.description: Learn CSS values, units, calculations, and reusable functions.

children.name: Box Model
children.description: Understand how CSS calculates the size and spacing of elements.

children.name: Typography
children.description: Control text appearance, readability, spacing, and web fonts.

children.name: Colors & Backgrounds
children.description: Learn backgrounds, gradients, transparency, and modern color systems.

children.name: Display & Normal Flow
children.description: Understand how elements participate in normal document flow.

children.name: Positioning
children.description: Control element positioning relative to the document, containing blocks, and viewport.

children.name: Flexbox
children.description: Master one-dimensional CSS layout with Flexbox.

children.name: CSS Grid
children.description: Master two-dimensional CSS layout with Grid.

children.name: Spacing, Alignment & Sizing
children.description: Build reliable layouts using modern spacing, sizing, and alignment techniques.

children.name: Borders, Shadows & Effects
children.description: Style surfaces, borders, shadows, clipping, and visual effects.

children.name: Pseudo-classes
children.description: Style elements according to state, position, interaction, and structural conditions.

children.name: Pseudo-elements
children.description: Create and style generated content and parts of elements.

children.name: Transitions
children.description: Create smooth state changes and interactive visual effects.

children.name: Transforms
children.description: Transform elements in two and three dimensions.

children.name: Animations
children.description: Create keyframe-based CSS animations.

children.name: Responsive Design
children.description: Build layouts that adapt to different screen sizes and devices.

children.name: CSS Architecture
children.description: Organize CSS into scalable, maintainable systems.

children.name: Modern CSS
children.description: Learn modern CSS capabilities used in contemporary frontend development.

children.name: Accessibility
children.description: Use CSS in ways that preserve accessibility, readability, focus visibility, and user preferences.

children.name: CSS Debugging & DevTools
children.description: Diagnose layout, cascade, specificity, rendering, and responsive issues using browser developer tools.

children.name: CSS Performance
children.description: Write efficient CSS and understand its impact on rendering performance.

children.name: CSS Preprocessors & Tooling
children.description: Understand preprocessing and modern CSS tooling used in production projects.

children.name: CSS Projects
children.description: Apply CSS knowledge through progressively more complex projects.
